A.label: grid-default
A.routeInstruction: Use the currently shipped Grid scaffold when no visual direction is supplied.

B.label: principles-only
B.routeInstruction: Use composition principles and free coordinates without selecting a registered Grid scaffold.

C.label: authoring-compiler
C.routeInstruction: Write a durable authoring plan, select zero to two design mechanisms, compose freely, and run design review.

tasks.goal: Turn a quarterly operating update into a decision-ready deck.
Explain a product metric change with evidence and next actions.
Present a research question, method, result, and limitation.
Turn a thesis outline into a concise defense narrative.
Explain a system boundary, data flow, and operational risks.
Compare two implementation options and recommend one.
Summarize a small dataset with honest charts and findings.
Turn a written analysis into an executive reading path.
Introduce a product, audience, proof, and launch action.
Create a visual launch story from a short product brief.

design.modelAndTokenBudget: must be recorded per run and held constant across arms

rolloutRule: Switch C to the no-direction default only when every threshold passes on this frozen pilot. Otherwise keep A shipped and record C as experimental.
